code: import axios from"axios";const API_BASE=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||"http://localhost:5000/api";const client=axios.create({baseURL:API_BASE});export const StudentAPI={list:params=>client.get("/students",{params}).then(r=>r.data),get:id=>client.get("/students/".concat(id)).then(r=>r.data),create:data=>client.post("/students",data).then(r=>r.data),update:(id,data)=>client.put("/students/".concat(id),data).then(r=>r.data),remove:id=>client.delete("/students/".concat(id)).then(r=>r.data),stats:()=>client.get("/students/stats/summary").then(r=>r.data),addPayment:(id,data)=>client.post("/students/".concat(id,"/payments"),data).then(r=>r.data),removePayment:(id,paymentId)=>client.delete("/students/".concat(id,"/payments/").concat(paymentId)).then(r=>r.data)};export const StaffAPI={list:()=>client.get("/staff").then(r=>r.data),create:data=>client.post("/staff",data).then(r=>r.data),update:(id,data)=>client.put("/staff/".concat(id),data).then(r=>r.data),remove:id=>client.delete("/staff/".concat(id)).then(r=>r.data)};export const OtpAPI={send:phone=>client.post("/otp/send",{phone}).then(r=>r.data),verify:(phone,otp)=>client.post("/otp/verify",{phone,otp}).then(r=>r.data)};export const PaymentAPI={list:params=>client.get("/payments",{params}).then(r=>r.data),summary:params=>client.get("/payments/summary",{params}).then(r=>r.data)};export function exportStudentsUrl(params){const query=new URLSearchParams(params||{}).toString();return"".concat(API_BASE,"/export/students").concat(query?"?".concat(query):"");}export default client;
